patch_description: Replace the central CRY with CRZ while retaining the same parameter count and circuit depth. A controlled phase perturbation is naturally aligned with the IsingZZ encoding and surrounding CZ graph, allowing each re-upload block to tune pairwise phase interference without prematurely converting it into asymmetric populations. The prior CRZ-based candidate achieved the strongest combined score (0.94), higher validation accuracy (0.96), and lower validation loss (0.23) than the current CRY design.
